correctness.rationale: The integrated clock A_t=tau*sum_{j<n}Lambda_j+u Lambda_n has Laplace exponent -sigma(n tau^alpha+u^alpha)s^alpha and hence law a(t)Z_alpha. Conditional Brownian survival is E[S_wedge(A_t)] because continuous exit under increasing time change is equivalent to operational-time exit. Dirichlet wedge first angular mode has exponent p=pi/(2 theta) with normalization (4/pi)Gamma(1+p)/Gamma(1+2p)*(r^2/(4D))^p sin(pi phi/theta); stable inverse moment Gamma(1+p/alpha)/Gamma(1+p) and dominated convergence give the stated K and sharp q<p/alpha moment cutoff. At alpha=1/2 inverse stable is Gamma(1/2), yielding the half-plane and quadrant Cauchy-ratio arctangents and right sqrt(u) cusp. For freely evolving unabsorbed process observed only at epochs, iid symmetric increments satisfy Sparre Andersen persistence >= binom(2n,n)/4^n, implying infinite mean even if continuous mean finite. The exact equality is only for zero-start persistence, and it is used as a lower bound for positive starting height.
